style.$comment: The content audit's patterns that a regular expression can find (01-audit.md section 4), checked in the copy only, by path. 'label' patterns apply to labels: a string whose last key is in labelKeys ('items' only inside inside.groups), outside the skip paths (questions and answers, chat and sample data, drawings of screens). 'all' patterns apply to every copy string outside the skip paths; 'body' to leads and bodies. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression with the u flag, and i where flags says so. A line kept on purpose goes in allow/banned.json under 'style', with its path, the pattern's name and its reason; an entry that matches nothing fails.

patterns.name: question
patterns.why: No questions outside the Questions section (pattern 4)

patterns.name: stacked
patterns.why: Two or more short sentences stacked as one label: 'Check. Set up. See.', 'New company. No shortcuts.' (patterns 3 and 5). A list item may be two plain sentences

patterns.name: colon
patterns.why: A colon reveal in a label (pattern 6). Callouts name a part of the screen and then say what it shows, and a list item may use a colon for its example, so those two are left to the reader

patterns.name: person
patterns.why: Personification beyond what the product does (pattern 10)

patterns.name: person-ar
patterns.why: Arabic personification (pattern 10). Matched without diacritics, as the check reads the copy
